name: ponte
description: Ponte: integração entre CRM e ERP com idempotência, retentativa, fila de falhas e reconciliação.

scripts.db:migrate: npm run db:migrate -w @ponte/mock-crm && npm run db:migrate -w @ponte/mock-erp && npm run db:migrate -w @ponte/integration
scripts.db:generate: npm run db:generate -w @ponte/mock-crm && npm run db:generate -w @ponte/mock-erp && npm run db:generate -w @ponte/integration
scripts.dev: concurrently -n crm,erp,ponte,console -c blue,green,magenta,yellow "npm run dev -w @ponte/mock-crm" "npm run dev -w @ponte/mock-erp" "npm run dev -w @ponte/integration" "npm run dev -w @ponte/console"
